title: cassia bicapsularis var. indecora
intro: Cassia bicapsularis var. indecora, commonly known as Kutu, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Cassia bicapsularis var. indecora include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and soothe respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
